entries.Original: Price Insight Config
entries.Translated: 价格洞察配置

entries.Original: Tap Alt to refresh prices
entries.Translated: 点击 Alt 以刷新价格

entries.Original: Prefetch prices for items in inventory
entries.Translated: 预测库存中物品的价格

entries.Original: Prefetch prices for all items in inventory, chocobo saddlebag and retainer when logging in.
entries.Translated: 登录时提前预览所有商品的价格，包括库存、巧克力马鞍袋和保留金。

entries.Original: Use current world as home world
entries.Translated: 使用当前世界作为家庭世界

entries.Original:
The current world you're on will be considered your "home world".
Useful if you're datacenter travelling and want to see prices there.
entries.Translated:
你当前所在的世界将被视为你的 “家”。
如果你正在数据中心旅行，想看看那里的价格，这很有用。

entries.Original: Show cheapest price in:
entries.Translated: 显示最便宜的价格：

entries.Original: Region
entries.Translated: 地区

entries.Original: Datacenter
entries.Translated: 数据中心

entries.Original: Home world
entries.Translated: 家庭世界

entries.Original: Show most recent purchase in:
entries.Translated: 显示最近的购买情况：

entries.Original: Show the average sales per day based on sales of the last 4 days.
entries.Translated: 显示基于过去 4 天销售额的每日平均销售额。

entries.Original: Show the average sale price based on sales of the last 4 days.
entries.Translated: 显示基于过去 4 天销售额的平均销售价格。

entries.Original: Show stack sale price
entries.Translated: 显示堆栈销售价格

entries.Original: Show the price of the hovered stack if sold at the given unit price.
entries.Translated: 显示如果以给定单价出售，浮动堆栈的价格。

entries.Original: Show age of data
entries.Translated: 显示数据的年龄

entries.Original:
Show when the price info was last refreshed.
Can be turned off to reduce tooltip bloat.
entries.Translated:
显示上次更新价格信息的时间。
可以关闭以减少工具提示膨胀。

entries.Original: Show datacenter for foreign worlds
entries.Translated: 向外部世界展示数据中心

entries.Original:
Show the datacenter for worlds from other datacenters when displaying prices for the entire region.
Can be turned off to reduce tooltip bloat.
entries.Translated:
显示整个区域的价格时，显示来自其他数据中心世界的数据中心。
可以关闭以减少工具提示膨胀。

entries.Original: Always display NQ and HQ prices
entries.Translated: 始终显示 NQ 和 HQ 价格

entries.Original:
Show the prices for both NQ and HQ of an item.
When turned off will only display price for the current quality (use Ctrl to switch between NQ and HQ).
entries.Translated:
显示商品的 NQ 和 HQ 价格。
当关闭时，只显示当前质量的价格 (使用 Ctrl 在 NQ 和 HQ 之间切换)。

entries.Original: Include all datacenters available via datacenter traveling.
entries.Translated: 包括通过数据中心旅行提供的所有数据中心。

entries.Original: Price Insight Configuration Menu
entries.Translated: Price Insight 配置菜单
